name: io.github.amangeldievkuu/tdx-taiwan-mcp
title: Taiwan TDX transport
description: Taiwan transport via TDX: YouBike, buses, rail, flights, ferries, road traffic, parking, EV

environmentVariables.name: TDX_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: TDX API key Client Id (tdx.transportdata.tw → 會員中心 → 資料服務 → API金鑰).

environmentVariables.name: TDX_REQUESTS_PER_SECOND
environmentVariables.description: Client-side rate limit; match it to your TDX plan (0 turns it off).

environmentVariables.name: TDX_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to load: bike, bus, rail, flight, ferry, road, parking, ev, raw; e.g. bus,rail or -road,-raw.

environmentVariables.name: TDX_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where static data is kept for a day between runs (default ~/.cache/tdx-taiwan-mcp); off turns it off.
